title: PlanReadyData
description: data of the plan.ready event (SDD 11). Producer: Reading Coach (W3). Consumer: Passage Generator (W2), which pre-generates the next story from story_requests/story_{session_id} and reads nothing in data but the envelope's session_id. plan_ref is the Firestore path of the plan; template_used is true when the Coach's summary failed the validator twice (COACH_TEMPLATE_USED).
